own_solution.law: Exponential decay in proper time with time dilation: N/N0 = exp(-L m c^2 / (p c * c tau)), decay length = (pc/mc^2) c tau
assumptions: all pions have the same momentum and constant speed

notes: c tau = 2.998e8 * 26.03e-9 = 7.80379 m; gamma beta = 4000/139.57 = 28.6595; decay length = 223.652 m. Base: exp(-100/223.652) = exp(-0.44712) = 0.63947. With tube 134 m: exp(-0.59914) = 0.54928. Number of pions per spill cancels from the fraction (C). Cooling-water line and earlier-run extensions have no path (D). TA31E and TFEF0 carry no number ('small amount'), apparently numeral-free variants. (The key TA551_note is a stray null placeholder, not a sentence.)
